Select the first 500 exact activity measurements for compounds tested against thyroid hormone receptor CHEMBL1862. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1862. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '='. Return columns chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Sort by potency ascending (standard_value). Limit to 500 rows. Do not deduplicate.
